attempts.description: id="bookDescription_feature_div" class="celwidget" data-feature-name="bookDescription" data-csa-c-type="widget" data-csa-c-content-id="bookDescription" data-csa-c-slot-id="bookDescription_feature_div" data-csa-c-asin="1590207149" data-csa-c-is-in-initial-active-row="false"> This is the engrossing, hilarious, and utterly compelling story of how the Stephen the world knows (or thinks it knows) found his way.
